‘one whose bow is drawn to take another's life’, endeavouring to kill some one, a murderer, Mn. viii, 350 seq.; MBh. &c. (in later texts also incendiaries, ravishers, thieves &c. are reckoned among आततायिनस्).

[आततेन विस्तीर्णेन शस्त्रादिना अयितुं शीलमस्य Tv.] 1 ‘One whose bow is stretched to take another's life’, endeavouring to kill some one; a desperado; गुरुं वा बालवध्वौ वा ब्राह्मणं वा बहुश्रुतं . आततायिनमायांतं हन्यादेवाविचारयन् .. Ms. 8. 350-1; Bg. 1. 36. --2 Any one who commits a heinous crime, such as a thief, ravisher, murderer, incendiary, a felon &c; अग्निदो गरदश्चैव शस्त्रोन्मत्तो धनापहः . क्षेत्रदारहरश्चैतान् षड् विद्यादाततायिनः .. Śukra. ˚ता, --त्वं murdering, stealing, destroying &c.

“BUtendriyamanobudDivAsanAkAryavAyavaH । avidyA cAzwakaM proktaM puryyazwakamidaM punaH” sanandokteH “puryyazwakena liNgena prARAdyena sa yujyate । tena badDasya vE banDomokzImuktasya tena vE” brahmapu॰ ukteSca maMsftikAle puryyazwakasya paralokagAmitvasidDeH । AtivAhikaSarIrasattve'nyaTAnupapattireva pramARam tatsvarUpaYcoktaM sAMKyasUtraBAzyAdO । “tadvIjAt saMsftiH” sU॰ । tasya SarIrasya vIjAt trayoviMSatitattvarUpAt sUkzmAdDetoH puruzasya saMsftirgatAgate BavataH kUwasTasya viButayA svato gatyAdyasamBavAdityarTaH trayoviMSatitattve'vasTito hi puruzastenEvopADinA pUrvvakftakarmaBogArTaM dehAddehaM saMsarati । “mAnasaM manasEvAyamupaBuNkte SuBASuBam । vAcA vAcA kftaM karma kAyenEva tu kAyikam” ityAdismftiBiH pUrvasargIyakaraRErevotsagetaH sargAntarezUpaBogasidDeH । ataeva brahmasUtram “tadantarapratipattO raM hati samparizvakta iti” । saMsfteravaDimapyAha । “AvivekAcca pravarttanamaviSezARAm” sU॰ । “ISvarAnISvaratvAdiviSezarahitAnAM sarvezAmeva puMsAM vivekaparyyantameva pravarttanaM saMsftirAvaSyakI vivekottaraM ca na sA tatra hetumAha । “upaBogAditarasya” sU॰ । itarasyAvivekina eva svIyakarmaPalaBogAvaSyamBAvAdityarTaH । dehasattve'pi saMsftikAle Bogo nAstItyAha । “samprati parimukto dvAByAm” sU । samprati saMsftikAle puruzo dvAByAM SItozRasuKaduHKAdidvandvEH parimukto BavatItyarTaH । tadetatkArikayoktam । “saMsarati nirupaBogaM BAvEraDivAsitaM liNgam” । iti । BAvA DarmADarmavAsanAdayaH । ataH paraM SarIradvayaM viSizya vaktumupakramate । “mAtApitfjaM sTUlaM prAyaSa itaranna taTA” sU॰ । sTUlaM mAtApitfjaM prAyaSo bAhulyenAyonijasyApi sTUlaSarIrasya smaraRAditaracca sUkzmaSarIraM na taTA na mAtApitfjaM sargAdAvutpannatvAdityarTaH । taduktaM kArikayA । “pUrvvotpannamasaktaM niyataM mahadAdi sUkzmaparyantam । saMsarati nirupaBogaM BAvEraDivAsitaM liNgam” iti niyataM nityaM dviparArDasTAyi gORanityaM pratiSarIraM liNgotpattikalpane gOravAt । pralaye tu tannASaH SrutismftiprAmARyAdizyate । gatikAle BogABAvavacanamutsargABiprAyeRa । kadAcit tu vAyavIyaSarIrapraveSato gamanakAle'pi Bogo Bavati । ato yamamArge duHKaBogavAkyAnyupapadyante । sTUlasUkzmaSarIrayormaDye kimupADikaH puruzasya dvandvayogastadavaDArayati । “pUrvotpattestatkAryatvaM BogAdekasya netarasya” sU॰ । pUrvaM sargAdAvutpattiryasya liNgaSarIrasyatasyEva tatkAryatvaM suKaduHKakAryakatvaM kuta ekasya liNgadehasyEva suKaduHKAKyaBogAt na tvitarasya sTUlaSarorasya mftaSarIre suKaduHKAdyaBAvasya sarvasammatatvAdityarTaH । uktasya sUkzmaSarIrasya svarUpamAha । “saptadaSEkaM liNgam” sU॰ । sUkzmaSarIramapyaDArADeyaBAvena dviviDaM Bavati tatra saptadaSa militvA liNgaSarIraM tacca sargAdO samazwirUpamekameva BavatItyarTaH । ekAdaSendriyARi paYca tanmAtrARi budDiSceti saptadaSa । ahaNkArasya budDAvevAntarBAvaH । caturTasUtre vakzyamARapramARAdetAnyeva saptadaSaliNgaM mantavyaM na tu saptadaSa ekaM cetyazwAdaSaparatayA vyAKyeyam । uttarasUtreRa vyaktiBedasyopapAdyatayAtra liNgEkatve ekaSabdasyatAtparyAbaDAraRAcca । “karmAtmA puruzo yo'sO banDamokzEH prayujyate । sa saptadaSakenApi rASinA yujyate ca saH” iti mokzaDarmAdO liNgaSarIrasya saptadaSatvasidDeSca saptadaSAvayavA atra santIti saptadaSako rASirityarTaH । rASiSabdenasTUladehavalliNgadehasyAvayavitvaM nirAkftam । avayavirUpeRa dravyAntarakalpanAyAM gOravAt । sTUladehasya cAvayavitvamekatAdipratyakzAnuroDena kalpyata iti । atra ca liNgadehe budDireva praDAnetyASayena liNgadehasya BogaH prAguktaH । prARaScAntaHkaraRasyEva vfttiBedaH । ato liNgadehe prARapaYcakasyApyantarBAva ityasya saptadaSAvayavakasya SarIratvaM svayaM vakzyati “liNgaSarIranimittaka iti sanandanAcArya” iti sUtreRa । ato BogAyatanatvameva muKyaM SarIralakzaRam । tadASrayatayA tvanyatra SarIratvamiti paScAdvyaktIBavizyati । “cezwendriyArTASrayaH SarIramiti” tu nyAye'pi tasyEva lakzaRaM kftamiti । nanu liNgaMcedekaM tarhi kaTaM puruzaBedena vilakzaRA BogAH syustatrAha । “vyaktiBedaH karmaviSezAt” sU॰ yadyapi sargAdO hiraRyagarBopADirUpamekameva liNgaM taTApi tasya paScAdvyaktiBedo vyaktirUpeRAMSato nAnAtvamapi Bavati । yaTedAnImekasya pitfliNgadehasya nAnAtvamaMSato Bavati putrakanyAdiliNgadeharUpeRa । tatra kAraRamAha karmaviSezAditi । jIvAntarARAM BogahetukarmAderityarTaH । atra viSezavacanAt samazwisfzwirjIvAnAM sADAraREH karmaBirBavatItyAyAtam । ayaM ca vyaktiBedo manvAdizvapyuktaH । yaTA manO samazwipuruzasya zaqindriyotpattyanantaram । “tezAM tvavayavAn sUkzmAn zaRRAmapyamitOjasAm । sanniveSyAtmamAtrAsu sarvaBUtAni nirmame” iti zaRRAmiti samastaliNgaSarIropalakzaRam । AtmamAtrAsu cidaMSezu saMyojyetyarTaH । taTA ca tatrEva vAkyAntaram । “tacCarIrasamutpannEH kAryEstEH karaREH saha । kzetrajYAH samajAyanta gAtreByastasya DImataH” । iti nanvevaM BogAyatanatayA liNgasyEva SarIratve sTUle kaTaM SarIratvavyavahArastatrAha । “tadaDizWAnASraye dehe tadvAdAt tadvAdaH” sU॰ । tasya liNgasya yadaDizWAnamASrayo vakzyamARaBUtapaYcakaM tasyASraye zAwkOSike dehe tadvAdo dehavAdastadvAdAt tasyADizWAnaSabdoktasya dehasya vAdAdityarTaH liNgasambanDvAdaDizWAnasya dehatvamaDizWAnASrayatvAcca sTUlasya dehatvamiti paryavasito'rTaH । aDizWAnaSarIraM ca sUkzma paYcaBUtAtmakaM vakzyate taTA ca SarIratrayaM sidDam । yat tu “AtivAhika ekI'sti deho'nyastvADiBOtikaH । sarvAsAM BUtajAtAnAM brahmaRastveka eva kim” ityAdiSAstrezu SarIradvayameva SrUyate talliNgaSarIrADizWAnaSarIrayoranyo'nyaniyatatvena sUkzmatvena cEkatABiprAyAditi । nanu zAwkOSikAtirikte liNgaSarIrADizWAnaBUte SarIrAntare kiM pramARamityAkANkzAyAmAha । “na svAtantryAt tadfte CAyAvaccitravacca” sU॰ । “talliNgaSarIraM tadfte'DizWAnaM vinA svAtantryAnna tizWati । yaTA CAyA nirADArA na tizWati yaTA vA citramityarTaH taTA ca sTUladehaM tyaktrA lokAntaragamane liNgadehasyADAraBUtaM SarIrAntaraM siDyatIti BAvaH । tasya ca svarUpaM kArikAyAmuktam । “sUkzmA mAtApitfjAH saha praBUtEstriDA viSezAH syuH । sUkzmAstezAM niyatA mAtApitfjA nirvantate” iti । atra tanmAtrakAryaM mAtApitfjaSarorApekzayA sUkzmaM yadBa tapaYcakaM yAvalliNgasTAyi proktaM tadeva liNgADizWAnaM SarIramiti labDaM kArikAntareRa । “citraM yaTASrayamfte sTARvAdiByo vinA yaTA CAyA । tadvadvinA viSezErna tizWati nirASrayaM liNgam” । iti । viSezEH sTUlaBUtEH sUkzmAKyEH, sTUlAvAntaraBedEriti yAvat । asyAM kArikAyAM sUkzmAKyAnAM sTUlaBUtAnAM liNgaSarIrAdBedAvagamena “pUrvotpannamasaktaM niyataM mahadAdi sUkzmaparyantam” । ityAdipUrvodAhftakArikAyAM sUkzmaBUtaparyantasya liNgatvaM tArTaH kintu mahadAdirUpaM yalliNgaM tat svADArasUkzmaparyantaM saMsarati tena saha saMsaratItyarTaH । nanvevaM liNgaGawakapadArTAH kiyanta iti kaTamavaDAryamiti cet । “vAsanABUtasUkzmaM ca karmAvidye taTEva ca । daSendriyaM mano budDiretalliNgaM vidurbuDAH iti vASizWAdivAkyeByaH । atra liNgaSarIrapratipAdanenEva puryazwakamapi vyAKyeyamityASayena budDiDarmARAmapi vAsanAkarmAvidyAnAM pfTagupanyAsaH । BUtasUkzmaM cAtra tanmAtrA । daSendriyARi ca jYAnakarmendriyaBedena purodvayamityASayaH । yat tu mAyAvAdino liNgaSarIrasya tanmAtrasTAne prARAdipaYcakaM prakzipanti puryazwakaM cAnyaTA kalpayanti tadaprAmARikamiti । nanu mUrtadravyatayA vAyvAderiva liNgasyAkASamevAsaNgenADAro'stu vyarTamanyatra saNgakalpanamiti tatrAha । “mUrtatve'pi na saNGAtayogAt taraRivat” sU॰ mUrtatve'pi na svAtantryAdasaNgatayAvasTAnaM prakASarUpatvena sUryasyeva saNGAtasaNgAnumAnAdityarTaH । sUryAdIni sarvARi tejAMsi pArTivadravyasaNgenEvAvasTitAni dfSyante liNgaM ca sattvaprakASaBayamato BUtasaNgatamiti । liNgasya parimARamavaDArayati । “aRuparimARaM tatkftiSruteH” sU॰ talliNgamaRuparimARaM paricCinnaM na tvatyantamevARu sAvayavasyoktatvAt । kutaH kftiSruteH kriyASruteH । “vijYAnaM yajYaM tanute karmARi tanute'pi ca” ityAdiSrutervijYAnAKyabudDipraDAnatayA vijYAnasya liNgasyAKilakarmaSravaRAdityarTaH । viButve sati kriyA na saMmBavati । tadgatiSruteriti pAWastu samIcInaH । liNgaSarIrasya ca gatiSrutiH “tamutkrAmantaM prARo'nUtkrAmati prARamanUtkrAmantaM savijYAno Babati savijYAnamevAnUtkrAmatIti” savijYAno budDisahita eva jAyate savijYAnaM yaTA syAt yaTA saMsarati cetyarTaH । paricCinnatve yuktyantaramAha । “tadannamayatvaSruteSca” sU॰ tasya liNgasyEkadeSato'nnamayatvaSruterna viButvaM samBavatIti । viButve sati nityatApatterityarTaH । sA ca SrutiH “annamayaM hi sOmya! mana ApomayaH prARastejomayI vAgityAdiH” । yadyapi mana AdIni na BOtikAni taTApyannasaMsfzwasajAtIyAMSapUraRAdannamayatvAdivyavahAro boDyaH । acetanAnAM liNgAnAM kimarTaM saMsftirdehAddehAntarasaYcAra ityASaNkAyAmAha । “puruzArTaM saMsftirliNgAnAM sUpakAravadrAjYaH” sU॰ yaTA rAjYaH sUpakArARAM pAkaSAlAsu saYcAro rAjArTaM taTA liNgaSarIrARAM saMsftiH puruzArTamityarTaH” pra॰ BAzyam sUkzmadehasattve pramARaM sAMKyatattvakOmudyAmitTaM darSitam । “syAdetadbudDireva sAhaNkArendriyA kasmAnna saMsarati kftaM sUkzmaSarIreRAprAmARikenetyata Aha । “citraM yaTASrayamfte sTARvAdiByovinA yaTA CAyA । tadvadvinA viSezErna tizWati nirASrayaM liNgam” । liNganAt jYApanAt budDyAdayoliNgaM tat anASritaM na tizWati । janmaprayARAntarAle budDyAdayaH pratyutpannaSarIraSritAH pratyutpannapaYcatanmAtravattve sati budDyAditvAt dfSyamAnaSarIravfttibudDyAdivat । vinA viSezEriti sUkzmEH SarIrErityarTaH । AgamaScAtra Bavati “aNguzWamAtraM puruzaM niScakarza yamovalAditi” । aNguzWamAtratvena sUkzmatAmupalakzayati AtmanonizkarzAsamBavena sUkzmameva SarIraM puruzastadapi hi puri sTUlaSarIre Sete” । evaYca sarvezAM BUtAnAM saMsaraRakAle sUkzmadehasyAvaSyakatve sTite manuzyARAmeva dAhAdyUrdDam AtivAhikadehAntarotpattirnatvanyezAM prAguktavacanAt asati tu dAhAdo nfRAM SmASAnikaBUtaBAvaprAptiriti BedaH yaToktam” SudDita॰ vizRu॰ । “ativAhikasaMjYo'sO deho Bavati BArgava! । kevalaM tanmanuzWARAM nAnyezAM prARinAM kvacit” ityupakramya pretapiRqEstaTA dattErdehamApnoti BArgava! । Bogadehamiti proktaM kramAdeva na saMSayaH । pretapiRqA na dIyante yasya tasya vimokzaRam । SmASAnikeByo BUteByo nAkalpameva vidyate । tatrA'sya GAtanA GorA SItavAtAtapIdBavA iti” atra pre takAryyAkaraRe dozABiDAnam । nindArTavAdI viDeyastutyarTam “na nindyaM nindanIyaM nindati kintu viGeyaM stotAti” nyAyAt । etacca vidvadBinnavizayam CA॰ u॰ viduzaH dEvAttadakaraRe'pi arcirAdiprApterukteH “aTa yadu cEvAsmin SavyaM kurvvanti yadi na, arcizamevABisanDavantIti” । etadBAzyaYca 651 pfzWe prAg darSitan । evaM gayASrAdDAdAvapi “agnidagDASca ye jIvA nAgnidagDAstaTA'pare tezAmuradDaRArTAya imaM piRqaM dadAmyahamiti । mantraliNkenAnagnidagDasyApyudDArapratipAdanAt । nizkarzasta saMsftikAle prARimAtrasya sUkzmadehaprAptiH tatra paSvAdInAM dAhAdikarmmAdikamantareRApi svasvakarmmAnusAreRa dehAntaraprAptiH manuzyARAntu vidvadAdivyatiriktAnAM dAhAdikamantareRa SmASAnikaBUtaBAvaprAptiH kfte tu dAhAdO AtivAhikadehaprAptiH pUrakapiRqAdO punaH pretadehaprAptiH sapaRqIkaraRAtparaM BogadehaprAptiH । tIrTamftAnAM na tu pretadeha iti BedaH “kfte sapiRqIkaraRe naraH saMvatsarAtparam । pretadehaM parityajya BogadehaM prapadyate ityukteH” “tataH sa narakeyAti svarge vA svena karmaRA” ityukteSca viduzAM mahAtIrTamftAnAM tu dEvAt dAhAdikAryyAkaraRe'pi arccirAdimArgeRa tattatsTAnayogyadehaprAptiriti ।

शम्बरारिर्मनसिजः कुसुमेषुरनन्यजः। पुष्पधन्वा रतिपतिर्मकरध्वज आत्मभूः। अरविन्दमशोकं च चूतं च नवमल्लिका। नीलोत्पलं च पञ्चैते पञ्चबाणस्य सायकाः। उन्मादनस्तापनश्च शोषणः स्तम्भनस्तथा। संमोहनश्च कामस्य पञ्च बाणाः प्रकीर्तिताः॥

the soul, principle of life and sensation, RV.; AV. &c.

आत्मन् [Old Germ. ātum; Angl.Sax. ædhm; Mod. Germ. Athem, Odem; Gk. ἀϋτμήν, ἀτμός (?).]
a: आत्मन् — m. [अत्-मनिण् Uṇ. 4. 152 said to be from अन् to breathe also] 1 The soul, the individual soul, the breath, the principle of life and sensation; किमात्मना यो न जितेंद्रियो भवेत् H. 1; आत्मानं रथिनं विद्धि शरीरं रथमेव तु Kaṭh. (In H. 4. 87 आत्मन् is compared to a river). --2 Self, oneself; in this sense mostly used reflexively for all three persons and in the singular number, masculine gender, whatever be the gender or number of the noun to which it refers; अनया चिंतयात्मापि मे न प्रतिभाति Ratn. 1; आश्रमदर्शनेन आत्मानं पुनीमहे Ś. 1; गुप्तं ददृशुरात्मानं सर्वाः स्वप्तेषु वामनैः R. 10. 60, 4. 35, 14. 57; Ku. 6. 20; देवी… प्राप्तप्रसवमात्मानं गंगादेव्यां विमुंचति U. 7. 2; गोपायंति कुलस्त्रिय आत्मानमात्मना Mb.; K. 107; sometimes used in pl. also; Śi. 17. 19; Māl. 8. --3 Supreme deity and soul of the universe, Supreme Soul, Brahma; तस्माद्वा एतस्मादात्मन आकाशः संभूतः Up.; U. 1. 1; Ms. 1. 15, 12. 24. --4 Essence, nature; काव्यस्यात्मा ध्वनिः S. D., see आत्मक below. --5 Character, peculiarity. --6 The natural temperament or disposition. --7 The person or whole body (considered as one and opposed to the separate members of it); स्थितः सर्वोन्नतेनोर्वी क्रांत्वा मेरुरिवात्मना R. 1. 14; योस्यात्मनः कारयिता Ms. 12. 12; Ki. 9. 66. --8 Mind, intellect; मंदात्मन्, नष्टात्मन्, महात्मन् &c. --9 The understanding; cf. आत्मसंपन्न, आत्मवत् &c. --10 Thinking faculty, the faculty of thought and reason. --11 Spirit, vitality, courage. --12 Form, image; आत्मानमाधाय Ku. 3. 24 assuming his own form; 2. 61; संरोपितेप्यात्मनि Ś. 6. 23 myself being implanted in her. --13 A son; आत्मा वै पुत्रनामासि. --14 Care, efforts, pain. --15 The sun. --16 Fire. --17 Wind, air. आत्मन् is used as the last member of comp. in the sense of ‘made or consisting of’; see आत्मक. The form त्मन् is also found to be used; कृतार्थं मन्यते त्नानं Mb. [cf. Gr. atmos, aitmen] --Comp. --अधीन a. {1} dependent on oneself, independent. {2} sentient. existing. --(नः) {1} a son. {2} a wife's brother. {3} the jester or विदूषक (in dramatic literature). --अनुरूप a. worthy of oneself; Ku. 1. 18; R. 1. 33. --अनुगमनं personal attendance; R. 1. 88. --अपहार. concealing oneself; कथं वा आत्मापहारं करोति Ś. 1. --अपहारकः one who pretends to belong to a higher class than his own, an impostor, a pretender. --आदिष्ट a. self-counselled. --(ष्टः) a treaty dictated by the party wishing it himself; H. 4. 121. --आराम a. {1} striving to get knowledge (as an ascetic or योगिन्), seeking spiritual knowledge; आत्मारामा विहितरतयां निर्विकल्पे समाधौ Ve. 1. 23. {2} self-pleased, delighted in self; Bh. 3. 93; cf. Bg. 5. 24. --आशिन् m. a fish supposed to feed on its young, or on the weakest of its species; cf. मत्स्या इव जना नित्यं भक्षयंतिपरस्परं . Rām. --आश्रय a. dependent on oneself or on his own mind. --(यः) {1} self dependence. {2} innate idea, abstract knowledge independent of the thing to be known. --ईश्वर a. self-possessed, master of self; आत्मेश्वराणां न हि ज नु विघ्नाः समाधिभेदप्रभवो भवंति Ku. 3. 40. --उदयः self-exaltation or elevation; Śi. 2. 30. --उद्भव a. born or produced from oneself. --(वः) {1} a son; R. 18. 12. {2} Cupid. {3} sorrow, pain. --(वा) {1} a daughter. {2} intellect. {3} N. of a plant (माष्पर्णी.) --उपजीवित् m. {1} one who lives by his own labour; Ms. 7. 138. {2} a day-labourer. {3} one who lives by his wife (Kull. on Ms. 8. 362). {4} an actor, public performer. --उपनिषद् f. N. of an उपनिषद् which treats of the supreme spirit. --उपम a. like oneself. --(मः) a son. --काम a. {1} loving oneself, possessed of selfconceit, proud. {2} loving Brahma or the Supreme spirit only. --कार्यं one's own business, private affair. --कृत a. {1} self-executed, done by oneself. {2} done against one's own self. --गत a. produced in one's mind; ˚तो मनोरथः Ś. 1. --(तं) ind. aside (to oneself) being considered to be spoken privately (opp. प्रकाशं aloud); frequently used as a stage-direction in dramas; it is the same as स्यगतं which is thus defined; अश्राव्यं खलु पद्वस्तु तदिह स्यगतं मतं S. D. 6. --गतिः f. {1} course of the soul's existence. {2} one's own course. ˚गत्या by one's own act. --गुप्तिः f. a cave, the hiding place of an animal, lair. --ग्राहिन् a. selfish, greedy. --घातः {1} suicide. {2} heresy. --घातकः, घातिन् {1} a suicide, a self-destroyer; K. 174; व्यापादयेत् वृथात्मानं स्वयं योऽ ग्न्युदकादिभिः . अवैधेनैव मार्गेण आत्मघाती स उच्यते ... {2} a heretic. --घषः {1} a cock (calling out to himself). {2} a crow. --जः, --जन्मन् m. --जातः, प्रभवः, संभवः {1} a son; तमात्मजन्मानमजं चकार R. 5. 36: तत्यामात्मानुरूपायामात्मजन्मसमुत्मुकः R. 1. 33; Māl. 1; Ku. 6. 28. {2} Cupid. {3} a descendant. --जा {1} a daughter; वंद्यं युगं चरणयोर्जनकात्मजायाः R. 13. 78; cf. नगात्मजा &c. {2} the reasoning faculty, understanding. --जयः {1} one's own victory. {2} victory over oneself, self-denial or abnegation. --ज्ञः, विद् m. a sage, one who knows himself. --ज्ञानं {1} self-knowledge. {2} spiritual knowledge, knowledge of the soul or the supreme spirit; Ms. 12. 85, 92. {3} true wisdom. --तत्त्वं {1} the true nature of the soul or the supreme spirit. {2} the highest thing. ˚ज्ञः a sage versed in the Vedānta doctrines. --तुष्टि a. self-satisfied. (--ष्टिः f.) self. satisfaction. --त्यागः {1} self-sacrifice. {2} suicide. --त्यागिन् m. {1} a suicide; आत्मत्यागित्यो नाशौचोदकभाजनाः Y. 3. 6. {2} a heretic, an unbeliever. --त्राणं {1} self-preservation. {2} a bodyguard. --दर्शः a mirror; प्रसादमात्मीयमिवात्मदर्शः R. 7. 68. --दर्शनं {1} seeing oneself. {2} spiritual knowledge, true wisdom; Y. 3. 157; cf. Ms. 12. 91. --दा a. Ved. granting one's existence or life. --दानं self-sacrifice, resigning oneself --दूषि a. Ved. corrupting the soul; self-destroying. --देवता a tutelary deity. --द्रोहिन् a. {1} self-tormenting, fretful. {2} a suicide. --निंत्य a. being constantly in the heart, greatly endeared to oneself. --निंदा self-reproach. --निवेदनं offering oneself (as a living sacrifice to the deity). --निष्ठ a. one who constantly seeks for spiritual knowledge. --पराजित a. one who has lost himself (Ved.). --पुराणं N. of a work elucidating the Upaniṣads (consisting of 18 chapters). --प्रबोधः {1} cognition of the soul; self-consciousness. {2} title of an उपनिषद्. --प्रभ a. self-illuminated. --प्रवादः conversation about the supreme spirit. --प्रशंसा self-praise. --बंधुः, --बांधवः {1} one's own kinsman; आत्ममातुः स्वमुः पुत्रा आत्मपितुः स्वसुः सुताः . आत्ममातुलपुत्राश्च विज्ञेया ह्यात्मबांधवः Śabdak., i. e. mother's sister's son, father's sister's son, and mother's brother's son. {2} the soul, the self. --बोधः {1} spiritual knowledge. {2} knowledge of self. --भावः {1} existence of the soul. {2} the self proper, peculiar nature. {3} the body. --भू a. self-born, self-existent. --(भूः) --योनिः {1} N. of Brahmā; वचस्यवसिते तस्मिन् ससर्ज गिरमात्मभूः Ku. 2. 53, 3. 16, 5. 81. {2} N. of Viṣṇu. {3} of Śiva; Ś. 7. 35. {4} Cupid, god of love; Ku. 3. 70. {5} a son (--भूः f.) {1} a daughter. {2} talent, understanding. --भूत a. {1} self-produced; peculiar, belonging to. {2} attached, devoted, faithful; Ms. 7. 217 (Kull. = आत्मतुल्य). --(तः) {1} a son. {2} Cupid. --(ता) {1} a daughter. {2} talent. --भूयं {1} peculiarity, own nature. {2} Brahma. --मात्रा a portion of the Supreme spirit. --मानिन् a. self respecting, respectable. {2} arrogant, proud. --मूर्तिः {1} a brother; भ्राता स्वमूर्तिरात्मनः {2} soul, supreme spirit. --मूली N. of a plant (दुरालभा). --मूलि n. the universe. --याजिन् {1} sacrificing for oneself or himself. (--m.) a learned man who studies his own nature and that of the soul (of others) to secure eternal felicity, one who looks upon all beings as self; सर्वभूतेषु चात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि . समं पश्यन्नात्मयाजी स्वाराज्यमधिगछति; Ms. 12. 91. --योनिः = ˚भू (m.) q. v. Ku. 3. 70. --रक्षा {1} N. of a plant (इंद्रवारुणीवृक्ष). {2} self-protection. --लाभः birth, production, origin; यैरात्मलाभस्त्वया लब्धः Mu. 3. 1. 5. 23; Ki. 3. 32, 17. 19, 18. 34; K. 239. --लोमन् {1} the hair of the body. {2} the beard. --वंचक a. selfdeceiver. --वंचना self-delusion; selfdeception. --वधः, --वध्या, --हत्या. suicide. --वश a. depending on one's own will; Ms. 4. 159, 160 --(शः) {1} self-control, self-government. {2} one's control, subjection; ˚शं नी, ˚वशीकृ to reduce to subjection, win over. --वश्य a. having control over self, self-possessed, self-restrained. --विक्रयः sale of oneself or one's own liberty; Ms. 11. 60. --विद् m. {1} a wise man, sage; as in तरति शोकमात्मवित्. {2} knowing one's own self (family &c.); Śi. 2. 116. {3} N. of Śiva. --विद्या knowledge of the soul, spiritual knowledge; Ms. 7. 43. --विवृद्धिः, --वृद्धिः f. self-exaltation. --वीर a. {1} mighty, powerful, strong. {2} appropriate, suitable, good for oneself (as diet &c.). {3} existent, sentient. --(रः) {1} a son. {2} wife's brother. {3} a jester (in dramas). --वृत्तं, --वृत्तांतः account of one's own self, autobiography. --वृत्ति a. dwelling in Ātman or soul. (--त्तिः f.) {1} state of the heart; Ku. 5. 76. {2} action as regards oneself, one's own state or circumstance; विस्माययन् विस्मितमात्मवृत्तौ R. 2. 33. {3} practising one's own duties or occupation. --शक्तिः f. one's own power or ability, inherent power or effort; दैवं निहत्य कुरु पौरुषमात्मशक्त्या Pt. 1. 361 to the best of one's power. {2} illusion. --शल्या N. of a plant (शतावरी). --श्लाघा, --स्तुतिः f. self-praise, boasting, bragging. --संयमः self-restraint. --सद् a. Ved. dwelling in oneself. --संतुष्ट a. self-sufficient. --सनि a. Ved. granting the breath of life. --सम a. worthy of oneself, equal to oneself; Ku. 3. 13. --संदेहः {1} internal or personal doubt. {2} risk of life, personal risk. --संभवः, --समुद्भवः {1} a son; चकार नाम्ना रघुमात्मसंभवं R. 3. 21, 11. 57, 17. 8. {2} Cupid, god of love. {3} epithet of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, or Śiva. {4} the Supreme being (परमात्मन्). --(वा) {1} a daughter. {2} understanding, intellect. --संपन्न a. {1} self-possessed. {2} talented, intelligent; R. 18. 18. --सिद्धिः f. self-aggrandizement. --मुख a. self-delighted. --(खं) the highest bliss. --हन् a. {1} one who kills his own soul (neglects its welfare &c.). {2} a suicide, self-destroyer. {3} a heretic, unbeliever. {4} a priest in a temple, a servant or attendant upon an idol. --हननं, --हत्या suicide. --हित a. beneficial to oneself. --(तं) one's own good or welfare.

m: आत्मना instr. of आत्मन्, in comp. [but not in a Bahuvrīhi] with ordinals, Pāṇ. vi, 3, 6 (cf. the Bahuvrīhi compounds आत्म-चतुर्थ, and -पञ्चम.)
a: आत्मना — ind. (instr. of आत्मन्) Used reflexively; अथ चारतमिता त्वमात्मना R. 8. 51 thou thyself; आत्मना शुकनासमादाय K. 293. It is oft. compounded with ordinal numerals; e. g. ˚द्वितीयः second including himself, i. e. himself and one more; so ˚तृतीयः himself with two others &c.

m: आत्मना—दशम mfn. being one's self the tenth, Pat.
आत्मना—द्वितीय mfn. being one's self the second, i.e. together with some one else, Hit.
आत्मना—पञ्चम mfn. being one's self the fifth, R.
आत्मना—सप्तम mfn. being one's self the seventh, MBh. xvii, 25.
आत्मना—तृतीय mfn. ‘third with one's self’, being one's self the third, Śak.; Kathās.

s: tri, (Atman + KaH .) Atmane hitaM । iti vyAkaraRaM ॥ paTyaM । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (“BajanirvftimAtmanInAm” । iti praboDacandrodayaH .)
puM, (Atman + Ka .) sutaH । SyAlaH ॥ prARADAraH । vidUzakaH । ityajayaH ॥
v: tri॰ Atmane hitam Ka । 1 Atmahite “tAmAtmanInAmudavoQa rAmaH” BawwiH । “adyApi nEvAtmanInaM kftaM karma yAtaM januH” nItiH 2 putre 3 SyAle nAwakaprasidDe vidUzake ca pu॰ ajayaH 4 prARaDArake balini tri॰ ।
m: आत्मनीन mf(आ)n. (Pāṇ. v, 1, 9 and 6, 169) appropriate or good or fit for one's self, Prab.; Bhaṭṭ.
(= आत्माधीन, q.v.) sentient, L.
आत्मनीन m. a son, L.
a wife's brother, L.
the jester in a play, L.
a: आत्मनीन — a. [आत्मने हितः ख] 1 Belonging to oneself, one's own कस्यैष आत्मनीनः M. 4 on whose side is he? --2 Beneficial to oneself; आत्मनीनमुपतिष्ठते Ki. 13. 69, 3. 16; Bh. 3. 77; good, fit, suitable, appropriate (as diet &c.). --3 Existent. sentient. --नः 1 A son. --2 A wife's brother. --3 A jester (in dramas).

m: आत्मनीय mf(आ)n. one's own, Lalit.
आत्मने dat. in comp. for आत्मन्, Pāṇ. vi, 3, 7 and 8.

v: strI Atmane taduddeSena BASA pariBAzA aluk sa॰ । vyAkaraRaprasidDe AtmanepadaSabdArTe ।
m: आत्मने—भाषा f. = -पद, q.v., Pāṇ. vi, 3, 7, Kāś.
आत्मने—भाष mfn. id., Pat.

v: na॰ Atmane AtmArTaPalaboDanAya padam aluk sa॰ । AtmagAmiPalaboDake vyAraRaprasidDe taNAdO । “taNAnAvAtmanepadam” pA॰ “anudAttaNitaH Atmadepadam” । “svaritaYitaH kartraBiprAye kriyAPale” pA॰ ukteH AtmagAminyeva kriyAPale tatpadasya viDAnAt taTAtvam taN pratyAhAraH sa ca “taAtAM JaTAs ATAMDvam iq vahimahiN” pARinyuktaH” etezAM sTAne eva lakA raBede tattadrUpARi AdizwAni ।
m: आत्मने—पद n. ‘word to one's self’, form for one's self i.e. that form of the verb which implies an action belonging or reverting to self, the terminations of the middle voice, Pāṇ. i, 4, 100 and 3, 12.
a: आत्मनेपदं — [आत्मने आत्मार्थफलबोधनाय पदं अलुक स˚] 1 A voice for oneself, one of the two voices in which roots are conjugated in Sanskrit. --2 The terminations of this voice.

आत्मनिका f. N. of a woman, Kathās.
आत्म—निन्दा f. self-reproach, MBh. ii, 1542.
आत्म—निरालोक n. (with मुनि) N. of Śiva, MBh. xiii, 1183
आत्म—निरूपण n. N. of wk. by Śaṃkarācārya
आत्म—नित्य mfn. constantly in the heart, greatly endeared to one's self, MBh. i, 6080 [= स्व-वश Comm.]
आत्म—निवेदन n. offering one's self to a deity, BhP.

v: tri॰ Atmani AtmajYAne nizWA yasya । AtmajYAnamAtrAnveziRi brahmanizWe mumukzO ।

m: आत्म—निष्क्रयण mfn. ransoming one's self, ŚBr. xi; KauṣBr.

m: आत्मन्—विन् mfn. id., ŚBr. x, xiv.

आत्म—पात m. ‘descent of the soul’, re-birth, BhP.
आत्म—पूजा f. self-praise, MBh. ii, 1542; Pañcat.
आत्म—प mfn. guarding one's self, BhP.
आत्म—पञ्चक n. N. of wk. by Śaṃkarācārya
आत्म—पञ्चम mfn. being one's self the fifth one with four others, Pāṇ. vi, 3, 5; Pat. Comm.

with √ 1. कृ, to cause to become one with the supreme spirit, NṛsUp.
a: आत्मसात् — ind. In one's own possession, one's own; mostly in combination with कृ or भूः ˚कृ to appropriate to oneself, take for oneself; दुरितैरपि कर्तुमात्मसात् R. 8. 2 to bring under subjection or power; so ˚भू come under one's subjection.

v: tri॰ Atmane AtmajYAnAya tizWate yatate sTA--ka 4 ta॰ । 1 AtmasvarUpajYAnAya yatamAne Atmani manasi tizWati sTA--ka 7 ta॰ । 2 manovfttipadArTe tri॰ ।

v: pu॰ Atmano manasaH saMyamaH । cittasaMyamane “AtmasaMyamayogAgnO juhvati jYAnadIpite” gItA ।
m: आत्म—संयम m. self-restraint, Bhag. iv, 27.
आत्म—संयोग mfn. connexion with one's self. ib.

आत्म—सद् mfn. dwelling in (my-) self, AV. v, 9, 8.
आत्म—सम्भावना f. self-conceit, Kād.

आत्म—सम्भवा f. a daughter, R.

v: pu॰ samBavatyasmAt sam + BU--apAdAne ap AtmA samBavo yasya । tanUje 1 putre । “evamAttaratirAtmasamBavAn tAn niveSya caturo'pi tatra saH” । “cakAra nAmnA raGurAtmasaMBavam” “tadAtmasamBavaM rAjye mantrivfdDAH samAdaDuH” iti ca raGuH 2 manojanye tri॰ 3 kAme suKAdO pu॰ 4 kanyAyAM 5 budDO ca strI । 6 AkASAdO 7 BUte tri॰ । “tasmAdvA etasmAdAtmanaH AkASaH samBUta AkASAdvAyurvAyoragniragnerApaH adByaH pfTivIti” SrutyuktestezAM taTAtvam AtmasaMBUtAdayo'pyatra । AtmA paramAtmA samBavo'sya । 7 caturmuKe pu॰ AtmanA samBavati ac । 8 Sive 9 vizRO 10 paramAtmani ca pu॰ ।

N. of Kāma, Kād.

resembling the soul or supreme spirit, ChUp.

m: आत्म—तत्त्व n. the true nature of the soul or of the supreme spirit, ŚvetUp.

suicide, Daś.

v: tri॰ AtmA cittaM vaSyatayA'styasya matup masya vaH striyAM NIp । 1 vaSyacitte । “udayAdizvavikftirmanasaH sattvamucyate । AtmavAn sattvavAnukta” ityutpalamAlokte 2nirvikAracitte ca “prakftizvAtmajamAtmavattayA” raGuH “tasmAdasmin sadA yukto nityaM syAdAtmavAn dvijaH” । “gfhe gurAvaraRye vA nivasannAtmavAn dvijaH” “pUrvvaM pUrvvaM gurutaraM vidyAt vyasanamAtmavAn” “brahmahatyAkftaM pApaM vyApohatyAtmavattayA” iti ca manuH । “na tvAmevaMviDoBAvaH sprazwumarhati mAnada! । Atmavantamiva vyADiH puruzaM vfdDasevinam” BA॰ va॰ pa॰ 279 a॰ । AtmA prakASyatayA vidyate'sya । AtmaprakASake 3 SAstre “SrutamAvizkftamAtmavat tvayA” raGuH । AtmanA tulyA kriyA vati । 4 AtmatulyakriyAyAm avya॰ । “Atmavanmanyate jagat” iti nItiH “mAtfvat paradArezu paradravyezu lozwravat । Atmavat sarvaBUtezu yaH paSyati sa paRqita” iti cARakyaH ।

self-possessed, composed, prudent, Mn.; Yājñ.; MBh. &c.

self-resemblance, proportion, analogy, L.
